names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 19 noiembrie, «Sfântul Mucenic Varlaam».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 19 Νοεμβρίου, «Άγιος Βαρλαάμ», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the title on the name link behind his line for 19 ноября ст. ст., name page 352, «Варлаам Антиохиец, Кесарийский (Каппадокийский), мч.», with the rank word left off; the line itself gives the bare declined forename and nothing else. Both epithets are kept because the calendar prints both, although its own life page names only Antioch. `.tmp/foldchk.py` reports no folder holding this form, and the two other Barlaams of this same day stand on name pages 353 and 355 with different strings.

Read out of the Охридски пролог's heading for 19. новембар ст. ст., „Св. муч. Варлам.“ — «Св.» is “saint” and «муч.» is the `martyr` grade `types` already keeps, so both come off and the heading prints nothing else; Antioch is in the body. NOTE THE SPELLING: this book writes Варлам where the Russian calendar writes «Варлаам» with two а, and §6 stores a copied form as the book prints it rather than bending it towards another calendar. The same day gives the same string to `barlaam-of-india`, so the two make a fold of two, declared in `scripts/corpus-gate.mjs` in the same commit.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 19 ноября ст. ст. — «Мч. Варлаама (ок. 304).»
doxologia.ro, calendarul pentru 19 noiembrie — «Sfântul Mucenic Varlaam»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 19ης Νοεμβρίου — «Άγιος Βαρλαάμ»

attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/2903/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 19 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and the man is the folder's own: an old man brought before the eparch of Antioch and burnt in the right hand, which is what the see in the folder's name records. The page's heading gives «(; - 304)» and the narrative «(304 μ.Χ.)», so a death interval is proposed where the folder had none. The apolytikion names him and gives both ἦχος and model and is taken; the page's «Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον», «Ὁ Μάρτυς σου Κύριε», is the common of a martyr and carries a tone but no model, and is not drafted. The page adds a detail no row can hold — «Η Σύναξή του τελείται στη μονή του που βρίσκεται κοντά στο Πανάρετο» — and it goes in the life. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 02.12.2025 (19. новембар ст. ст.) — „Св. муч. Варлам.“

attestations.note: The day's second entry. `dates` CONFIRMED AND UNCHANGED: «Пострада овај преславни старац јунак 304. год.» is the same 304 the folder already holds off saint.gr, so the year now rests on two books and the interval is a point. No `related` row added: the two men the entry names are Basil the Great and John Chrysostom, both quoted on him and both already related both ways. WHAT THE ENTRY ADDS: that he was of Antioch, that the judge thought to mock him and to make the circumstances force the sacrifice, the coal set on his open palm with incense on the coal so that pain should make him throw it down before the idols and censer them unwillingly, and that he held it until his fingers burned through and fell off with the fire still on them and the palm burned through, and his whole body then fell dead; Basil's words that the right hand was stronger than the fire, for though the flame scorched the hand the hand held the fire as if it were ash; and Chrysostom's, that angels watched from on high and archangels looked on at a scene surpassing human nature, a man who contended and did not feel what is proper to men, who was himself at once the altar, the sacrifice and the priest. THE SERBIAN FORM «Варлам» IS GIVEN TO TWO FOLDERS BY THIS ONE DAY — this man and `barlaam-of-india`, the third entry's elder — so the day makes a fold of two by itself, and the key is written in the same commit.

hymns.text: Şi părtaş obiceiurilor şi următor scaunelor Apostolilor fiind, lucrare ai aflat, de Dumnezeu insuflate, spre suirea privirii la cele înalte. Pentru aceasta, cuvântul adevărului drept învăţând şi cu credinţa răbdând până la sânge, Sfinţite Mucenice Varlaam, roagă-te lui Hristos Dumnezeu să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — «Troparul Sfântului Mucenic Varlaam», glas 4. The text is the common of a hieromartyr and addresses him as «Sfinţite Mucenice», a rank neither the calendar's line nor the life gives him; it is printed under his name and is copied whole, as it stands

english.text: Sharer in the ways of the Apostles and successor to their thrones, thou didst find in action, O God-inspired one, the ascent to the vision of things on high. Therefore, rightly teaching the word of truth and enduring in the faith unto blood, hieromartyr Barlaam, pray to Christ God that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Νεανικὴν ἐνδεδυμένος ἀνδρείαν μαρτυρικήν, ἐν πολιᾷ καρτερίαν, σὺ ἐνεδείξω ἔνδοξε, δοξάσας τὸν Χριστόν. Τούτῳ δὲ προσήγαγες δεξιὰν κεκαυμένην, ὡς θυσίαν ἄμωμον τὴν ἁγίαν ψυχήν σου. μεγαλομάρτυς, πρέσβευε ἀεί, πᾶσιν δοθῆναι, Βαρλαάμ, συγχώρησιν.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος δ’, Ὁ ὑψωθεῖς ἐν τῷ Σταυρῷ — the first hymn on the page of «Άγιος Βαρλαάμ». It names him and no other saint, and calls him μεγαλομάρτυς; the rank is the hymn's and no type is added from it. The lower-case «μεγαλομάρτυς» after a full stop is the page's own.

english.text: Clothed in the martyr's courage of a young man, you showed endurance in grey hairs, glorious one, and glorified Christ; to him you brought your burnt right hand, and your holy soul as an unblemished sacrifice. Great martyr Barlaam, intercede always that forgiveness be given to all.

hymns.text: Явился еси преудивлен крепостию, всесожжения ливан благовонен себе принесл еси, жертву Христу, и венец почести приим Варлааме, присно моли за ны, страдальче.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 19 ноября ст. ст. — «Кондак мученика Варлаама»

english.text: Thou wast shown most wonderful in strength; thou didst offer thyself as fragrant frankincense of whole-burnt offering, a sacrifice to Christ, and didst receive the crown of honour, O Barlaam: pray for us always, O sufferer.

death.note: saint.gr heads the page «Αγιος Βαρλααμ (; - 304)» and the narrative repeats the year for the hearing: «όταν τον έφεραν μπροστά στον έπαρχο Αντιοχείας (304 μ.Χ.)». The page gives no year of birth, only «τα βαθιά γεράματα του».
